title: Finiteness of point counts and of closed points of bounded degree
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ with $k_0=\Fq$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], and let $Y_0$ be a $k_0$-scheme of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism].

1. For every finite field extension $K$ of $k_0$, the set $Y_0(K)=\operatorname{Hom}_{k_0}(\operatorname{Spec}K,Y_0)$ of $K$-valued points of $Y_0$ [def-weil-field-valued-points] is finite. In particular $\#Y_0(\mathbf F_{q^n})$ is a nonnegative integer for every $n\geq1$.
2. For every integer $m\geq0$, the set of closed points $x\in|Y_0|$ [def-weil-closed-points] with $\deg(x)\leq m$ [def-weil-closed-point-degree] is finite. In particular, for every $r\geq1$, the set of closed points of degree $r$ is finite.
